capabilities.description: Start a Codex session in an approved local workspace.
Send a follow-up prompt to an existing paired Codex session.
Read status and streamed events from a Codex session.
Read the workspace diff after Codex runs.

metadata.setup: Clone or download this repo on the working computer, install Codex CLI, then run the local bridge pairing script from the repo root. Pairing is the user approval gate; Codex runs do not start with extra approval prompts. The bridge defaults to Codex no-sandbox mode for hosts where bubblewrap sandboxing is unavailable; pass --sandbox workspace-write or --sandbox read-only when those modes work locally.
